modules.title: LED Challenges
modules.description: Learn programming step by step by lighting up a robot's LED strip, from single LEDs to animations.

modules.title: Command-Based Challenges
modules.description: Sixteen challenges on a simulated robot: commands, triggers, interrupts, your own subsystems, and PathPlanner autos, with a live command timeline.

modules.title: AdvantageKit Challenges
modules.description: Sixteen command-based challenges on logging and log replay: outputs, inputs, IO layers, deterministic code, and solving a mystery from a match log.

modules.title: Smart Steering Playground
modules.description: Drive a simulated swerve robot around obstacles, and write the smart steering that keeps it from crashing into them, like in Mario Kart.
